units: <cite ref="Meilah 16b">Meïl. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>האי ד׳ דידך היא</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="D00533"><he>דְּיוּקָא</he></cite>) this is merely thy own combination (that Rab’s opinion was delivered in connection with the Mishnah), but Rab himself recited merely a tradition (without reference to that special clause of the Mishnah).
